description: Component effects for the truly weak open-weights model, reduced to one trial per cell because the gateway allows it 5 requests per minute. claude-haiku-5-5 verified 38 of its first 40 baseline runs (a ceiling at which no configuration can raise success), so the success-rate question is asked of Gemma and of the gpt-5.4-nano records. The baseline is plan gemma-dev-baseline (same tasks, one trial).
